gpt-6.1-sol.pricingNotes: Standard USD per million input/cached-input/output tokens: $2/$0.1/$10. Cache writes cost $2.5/M. Estimates use uncached Standard rates; cache writes, Batch/Flex discounts, Fast/Ultrafast tiers, regional uplifts, taxes and credits are excluded. Provider native reasoning default is medium. gpt-6-astra.pricingNotes: OpenAI lists GPT-6 Astra Standard pricing at $10/1M input, $1/1M cached input, $12.50/1M cache write, and $50/1M output tokens. Above 272K input tokens, the full request uses $20/1M input, $2/1M cached input, and $75/1M output. Estimates use uncached standard rates. Cache writes, batch/flex discounts, fast mode, regional uplifts, enterprise pricing, taxes, and provider credits are ignored. Timing is an uncalibrated heuristic inherited from the previous flagship.

gpt-5.6-terra.pricingNotes: OpenAI lists GPT-5.6 Terra Standard pricing at $2/1M input tokens, $0.20/1M cached input tokens, $2.50/1M cache write tokens, and $12/1M output tokens. AutoShow uses uncached standard input/output rates for estimates. Batch, flex, priority, regional uplifts, cached-input discounts, cache-write charges, enterprise pricing, taxes, and provider credits are ignored.

gemini-4-argon.pricingNotes: Google lists Gemini 4 Argon Standard introductory pricing of $2/1M input and $10/1M output tokens through 2026-11-30, then $4/1M input and $20/1M output from 2026-12-01. Output includes thinking tokens. AutoShow conservatively records the standard rates, so estimates overstate cost during the introductory window. Implicit cache reads cost $0.10/1M then $0.20/1M; explicit caching and free tier are unsupported. No context price tier is published. Batch/flex/priority/Contributor rates, cache discounts, search grounding, taxes and provider credits are excluded. Automatic date transitions are unsupported; recheck the tariff by 2026-12-01. Timing is an uncalibrated heuristic inherited from Flash.

limits.notes: https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/models/gemini-4-argon documents a unified 1,048,576-token input, thinking and output window. Synchronous GenerateContent is capped at 65,536 thinking/output tokens. Long decode and continuation are not implemented.

gemini-3.8-flash.pricingNotes: Google lists Gemini 3.8 Flash Standard pricing at $1.50/1M input tokens and $7.50/1M output tokens effective 2027-01-01, with introductory pricing of $0.75/1M input tokens and $3.75/1M output tokens through 2026-12-31 and no published context tiers. AutoShow conservatively records the standard rates, so estimates overstate cost during the introductory window. Free tier, batch/flex/priority prices, context caching, taxes, and provider credits are ignored. Automatic date transitions are unsupported; recheck the tariff and refresh all three workflow price paths by 2027-01-01.

claude-opus-5-5.description: Claude Opus 5.5 — text and image input with native JSON output
claude-opus-5-5.pricingNotes: Standard rates are $4/$20 per million input/output tokens across the 1M context window. Cache reads cost $0.20/M; 5m writes $5/M and 1h writes $8/M. Adaptive thinking is always on; disabled thinking and manual budgets are rejected. Native default effort is medium; omitted/reset effort delegates to that provider default. AutoShow sends native output_config.format without forced tools or non-default sampling. Cache rates are metadata only; prompt caching is not requested. Batch, fast mode, regional premiums, enterprise pricing, taxes and credits are excluded. Token and latency estimates are uncalibrated heuristics inherited from the previous tier.

limits.notes: 1M context and 128K ordinary output tokens. AutoShow write limits each response to 16000 total thinking plus text tokens. Batch 300K output beta is excluded.

grok-4.7.description: Grok 4.7 — flagship text/image model with a 500K context window
grok-4.7.pricingTier: xAI global standard Chat API token pricing
grok-4.7.pricingNotes: The exact Grok 4.7 pricing row lists $2.00/1M input, $0.50/1M cached input, and $6.00/1M output below 200,000 prompt tokens; at 200,000 or more prompt tokens all request tokens use $4.00/$1.00/$12.00 per million respectively. Estimates and observed usage use uncached rates. Reasoning tokens are billable output. US regional pricing adds 10%; this adapter uses the global endpoint. Priority, subscription-only Fast, cache discounts, enterprise pricing, taxes and credits are excluded. The inherited latency heuristic is uncalibrated.

limits.notes: https://docs.x.ai/developers/grok-4-7 documents no text output limit. Chat Completions remains supported; its unset max_completion_tokens defaults to 128,000 visible output tokens, separate from reasoning tokens. Provider-native reasoning defaults to high and cannot be disabled. Batch is unsupported.
